subject: Decommission data sanitation staging plan and temporary hold request
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: extended hold for forensic logs during decommission

Hi Marissa,

We are starting the decommission of the acme-prod-42 environment the week of May 24 and need Redwood's help to preserve forensic evidence that will be needed for a pending compliance review. Our standard DPA retention window is fine for most customer records, but the compliance team is asking for the following exception:

- A hold on deletion/purge of system logs and backup snapshots related to acme-prod-42 for 90 days beyond your standard backup purge window.
- Export copies of logs (application + audit + access) in an encrypted container to be delivered to Acme’s S3 account if possible.

Can you confirm:
1) Whether Redwood can place a retention hold flag on the named snapshots and prevent automatic purge.
2) A list of subprocessor backup locations that would be involved (we need names and locations for our DPA appendix).
3) Any costs or operational lead time to run an emergency export and isolate the dataset.

Attaching a short evidence checklist from Acme that shows the types of files we expect to keep. We may need a short amendment to the DPA to capture the hold — please advise on the owner for that.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Liu
Head of Security Operations
Acme Health
security@acmehealth.com

Attachments: forensic-evidence-checklist.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: extended hold for forensic logs during decommission

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear ask and the checklist. Quoting your note below.

On Wed, May 12, 2027 at 9:15 AM Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acmehealth.com> wrote:
> We are starting the decommission...

Summary / proposed plan from Redwood:
1) Retention hold: We can place a temporary hold flag on the relevant snapshot lineage and associated KV caches. That hold prevents automated retention jobs from selecting those snapshots for purge.
2) Subprocessors: the primary backup subprocessor that would touch these snapshots is BrightCloud Backup (US-West region). Additionally, our cross-region archival partner is StorePoint (eu-west-1 for DR replication). We will provide a short subprocessor table for your DPA appendix.
3) Export & isolation: Engineering can produce an encrypted export (AES-256) of the named log buckets and snapshots. Estimated lead time: 3 business days to prepare and verify; cost estimate: $1,400 flat operational fee + standard egress charges (we'll provide a line-item estimate).

Proposed timeline (draft):
- 5/18: Redwood marks snapshot lineage with hold flag.
- 5/20: Engineering prepares export manifest and begins snapshot freeze.
- 5/24: Encrypted export completed and staged for transfer to Acme S3 (if you provide access).
- 8/22: End of 90-day hold window (unless extended by signed DPA amendment).

We will prepare a small DPA amendment draft that captures the one-time hold, the subprocessor list, and the export commitment. Kimberly, can you own the DPA draft/review? Jonas, please review the export checklist and confirm the estimated effort.

Next steps:
- Kimberly (Legal) to circulate DPA amendment draft for signature (can use DocuSign).
- Sarah to confirm S3 transfer details or preferred transfer method.
- Jonas to confirm snapshot names and whether any additional logs (K8s node logs) are required.

I attached a suggested Redwood ops snapshot plan and the DPA amendment draft for your review. If this captures what Acme needs, we will proceed on the timeline above.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-dpa-amendment-draft.docx; snapshot-plan-ops.xlsx
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: extended hold for forensic logs during decommission

Marissa — this looks good, thanks. Two quick clarifications:
1) Please include application debug logs and audit trail (not just infra/system logs) in the manifest.
2) Who will sign the DPA amendment from Redwood's side? We need a contact for our procurement team.

If you can confirm those two points I’ll get our S3 bucket access details to you and route the amendment for signature on our side.

Best,
Sarah

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: extended hold for forensic logs during decommission

Sarah — confirmed on both:
- Jonas confirms app debug logs and audit trail will be included in the export manifest; we will enumerate all log prefixes in the manifest and share for your sign-off prior to export.
- For the DPA amendment, Kimberly Park (Legal) will review and sign on behalf of Redwood once procurement countersigns; we will use DocuSign to streamline signatures.

Finalized items attached and links below:
- Snapshot manifest draft (will update after we run the inventory job on 5/18).
- DPA amendment draft (Kimberly to circulate final redlines by EOD Monday).
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/ACME-98765 — I’ve linked the amendment to the account record for approvals.

Subprocessors to be included in the DPA appendix: BrightCloud Backup (US-West), StorePoint (EU-DR), and TransferBridge (managed transfer service). Jonas will add the host regions and the contact emails to the appendix.

We will move forward on the 5/18 hold placement unless you request otherwise.

Thanks — I’ll loop back after the inventory job completes.

Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: snapshot-manifest-draft.csv; redwood-dpa-amendment-draft.docx
